program: Wingless training-only factorial attribution of motif-churn control features
question: Which training-only motif features, if any, explain why raw prediction-active churn failed to separate productive from zero-gain adaptation intervals in R25?
hypothesis: Replay the exact fourth-manifest R25 construction and include every adjacent interval with motif churn before evaluation labels are opened. For each entering/exiting motif compute only frozen training-state features: baseline_disagreement (motif.best differs the corresponding-budget baseline argmax for key[3]), support=motif.bestCount, and consistency=motif.consistency. Evaluate the complete 2×2×2 factorial over feature toggles GATE∈{off,on}, SUPPORT∈{off,on}, CONSISTENCY∈{off,on}. Each motif contribution is zero when GATE=on and baseline_disagreement=false; otherwise contribution=(bestCount if SUPPORT=on else 1)*(consistency if CONSISTENCY=on else 1). Interval score is sum contributions / interval_bytes. All eight scores for all churn intervals are frozen before sealed actual gains are computed. Afterward label intervals PRODUCTIVE when gain>0, ZERO_GAIN when gain==0, NEGATIVE when gain<0. For each cell report productive-vs-zero pairwise AUC and means. This is attribution only: no cell is installed into the allocator and no fourth-manifest result changes R23/R25 policies.

prior_evidence.interpretation: Binary prediction-active churn alone does not rank productive intervals above the zero-gain interval; support and consistency must be factored before any signal revision.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_factors.motif_support_definition: motif.bestCount from the corresponding lower budget for exiting motifs or upper budget for entering motifs
frozen_factors.motif_consistency_definition: motif.consistency from the corresponding lower budget for exiting motifs or upper budget for entering motifs
frozen_factors.baseline_disagreement_definition: motif.best != corresponding-budget baseline argmax for motif.key[3]
frozen_factors.contribution: if gate=true and baseline_disagreement=false then 0 else (bestCount if support=true else 1)*(consistency if consistency=true else 1)
frozen_factors.interval_inclusion: all R25 adjacent intervals with motif_entry_count+motif_exit_count>0, determined before evaluation labels

classification_rules.supported: valid and at least one factorial cell has productive-vs-zero pairwise AUC >=0.75 with mean productive score > mean zero-gain score
classification_rules.mixed: valid and at least one cell has AUC >0.5 with mean productive score > mean zero-gain score, but no cell reaches 0.75
classification_rules.negative: valid and no cell ranks productive intervals above zero-gain intervals
classification_rules.invalid: any parent, authority, source identity, split, budget grid, churn-interval inclusion, feature definition, factorial completeness, label isolation, deterministic replay, capacity, provenance, or accounting requirement fails

attribution_rule: Report every cell meeting AUC>=0.75. Feature attribution is descriptive only; no winner is selected for deployment or allocator revision.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, budgets, motif support/consistency definitions, baseline-disagreement rule, eight factorial cells, interval inclusion, label definitions, AUC threshold, evaluator, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: preregister one or more supported feature forms and validate prospectively on a new disjoint manifest before any allocator signal revision

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: move from structural churn features to training-only outcome-mechanism diagnostics rather than repeatedly reweighting motif churn
